name: the-zoom-keys-show-the-zoom-level-in-one-toast
description: Cmd+=, Cmd+- and Cmd+0 each show the active tab's zoom percent in the confirmation toast. Every press updates the one card keyed 'zoom', so the stack never holds a second zoom card. Each step polls for 'percent|cards', where cards counts only .ov-card, because toast-surface.js keeps a .toast shadow probe in the same stack.

actions.expression: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('.toasts .toast.ov-card .ctl'); return (t ? t.textContent : '') + '|' + document.querySelectorAll('.toasts .toast.ov-card').length; })()
